mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, measured by quarter-over-quarter percent change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 QoQ growth accelerates, but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed tightens policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4.5%, but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth decelerates by more than 2% YoY, it signals a supply crunch that will hurt corporate profits and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: YoY INDPRO growth decelerates by > 2%, but SPX 60-day returns are positive > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will slow economic growth and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS rises above 5%, but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) growth accelerates by more than 10% YoY, it signals a strong consumer demand that will boost corporate revenues and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: YoY HOUST growth accelerates by > 10%, but SPX 60-day returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth decelerates by more than 100,000 jobs per month for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening labor market that will hurt consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: MoM PAYEMS growth < -100,000 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: MoM PAYEMS growth decelerates by > 100,000 for 2 months, but SPX 20-day returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) YoY inflation rate rises above 3%, and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 2%, it signals a high inflation and low interest rate environment that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and FEDFUNDS < 2%, but SPX 60-day returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) growth accelerates by more than 5% YoY, and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a strong consumer demand and tight labor market that will drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: YoY RSAFS growth > 5% and UNRATE < 5%, but SPX 20-day returns are negative > 40% of the time.
